summary: List available RFI ball in court filter options
description: Returns a list of available RFI ball in court filter fields and options for RFIs on a specified Project

key.description: Login information ID of the user currently holding the ball in court. Pass as `filters[ball_in_court_id][]=<key>` on the RFI list endpoint.

value.description: Full name of the user holding the ball in court.
